limits: One local Chromium GPU/context; CPU submission is not GPU timing.
No energy, thermal or physical-device inference; 3600 frames are a bounded sustained sample.
Controlled comparison isolates a quiet scene; effect policies are assessed separately.
Flash screen samples three seconds per scene at a declared downsampled resolution and is not full WCAG certification.
Local Chromium iframe sizes are CSS viewport fixtures, not physical phone/OS or trusted touch evidence.
Synthetic form/click dispatch checks application paths, not native fullscreen/share activation.
Accessibility observations are scoped; no blanket WCAG or nonvisual gameplay claim.
